Game Overview

Epic Gaul puts players into a arcade experience centered on race through a vibrant backdrop as a daring Gaul, outsmarting relentless Romans and cunning traps. Swipe to dodge and attack, relying on quick reflexes and strategy. Masterful timing and magic potions are your allies to survive and set unbeatable high scores in this thrilling, nostalgic escape adventure.
